svg.title: Gabriel Zaniqueli Beltrame - Full Stack Developer
svg.desc: Gabriel Zaniqueli Beltrame / Full Stack Developer / Brazil. Shipping code since 2019. Building web applications since 2021. Responsive UIs with Angular and React. REST APIs with Spring Boot. Currently building with Angular/React + Spring Boot + Docker. Interested in software architecture, automation and developer tools. My goal: deliver applications that solve real problems at scale. Open to collaboration, freelance projects and new opportunities.
